name: Game Mode Switcher
author: silvaio
description: One-click Game Mode for Omarchy: optimize Hyprland, silence the desktop, and optionally launch Steam in Gamescope / Big Picture.

barWidget.description: Gamepad chip in the bar; click to enter or exit Game Mode

schema.label: Launch Steam in Gamescope / Big Picture
schema.description: When entering Game Mode, start Steam's Deck UI in Gamescope, or Big Picture if Gamescope is missing. Steam is fullscreened for the session, then returned to its previous workspace and layout. Leaving Big Picture or quitting Steam restores the desktop.
